priority_rules: Critical: a positive blood culture, or at least two physiologic findings plus at least one laboratory or maternal finding.
High: at least two physiologic findings, or one physiologic finding plus at least one laboratory or maternal finding.
Monitor: exactly one physiologic, laboratory, or maternal finding without another qualifying finding.
ranking_rules: Rank Critical above High, High above Monitor, and Monitor above Routine.
Within a tier, rank by the number and severity of current qualifying findings.
Birth day, birth location, and transfer status are context fields and must not replace current clinical evidence.
Historical outcomes may validate protocol performance but do not determine a current infant's priority.
clinical_boundary: This database triage supports clinician review and does not diagnose sepsis or independently authorize treatment.
